title: Home and the Today card
summary: Your day at a glance: orders due, critical vendors, the closing checklist and how sales compare with last week.

blocks.text: Home is the first page for most people. At the top, the **Today** card lists what needs doing today. When nothing is due it says All caught up.

items: **Orders due**: vendor orders due today or tomorrow, from the [Vendor Calendar](page:vendor_calendar). Open one to build that vendor's order.
**Critical**: vendors with steady sellers that are out of stock or about to be (Critical on [Reorder Candidates](page:reorder)).
**Closing checklist**: after 6 PM, a reminder when tonight's closing checklist isn't in yet.
**Sales vs last week**: yesterday's sales next to the same day last week, if you can see sales and use Insights.

blocks.text: When a Critical vendor has been dealt with, an admin can hide it from Today and from the morning critical-vendors alert, for everyone. It still shows on Reorder Candidates with a Hidden from Today tag.

items: **Order already placed**: the order went in another way (phone, WhatsApp, the vendor's rep). The vendor shows as Ordered until a delivery is recorded.
**Close**: it's handled. Pick a reason. It comes back when something new turns critical, and after 14 days at most.
**Skip this week**: hidden until the new store week starts, Monday at midnight.
**Remind me later**: later today, tomorrow 9 AM, in 3 days, or a day you pick up to 30 days ahead.

blocks.text: Admins can deal with an order due without opening it: **Order already placed**, **Skip this week** or **Other** with a note everyone sees. Each one has Undo.
Admins on the app: long-press the Critical or Orders due tile, or tap its ⋯.
